## Install

1. Download `Fence-In-Comms-Training_{{VERSION}}_x64-setup.exe` below (Windows 10/11, 64-bit).
2. Optional: compare its checksum with `SHA256SUMS.txt` (PowerShell: `Get-FileHash <file>`). The installer
   was built by GitHub Actions from this tag; you can verify that with
   `gh attestation verify <file> --repo carelesstuna/fence-in-comms-training`.
3. Run it. It installs for your user only and needs no admin rights. The installer is not code-signed, so
   Windows SmartScreen may warn you: *More info → Run anyway*.

The app is currently in German; radio calls are in English. Mostly written by AI, guided and tested by a
human – see the README. For flight-simulation training only, not for real-world aviation. Feedback and
corrections are welcome via Issues.
